 "content": "def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        objects.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)])
    height = max(map(len, objects))
    widths = [max(map(len, obj)) for obj in objects]
    out = []
    for r in range(height):
        row = []
        for obj, width in zip(objects, widths):
            row.extend(obj[r] if r < len(obj) else [0] * width)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
